about_the_game:
You step into a fantasy world for a new routine and set up a shop selling your own macarons with the goal of living well here!

Build enormous wealth by predicting residents' demand and building a production line that can sell the most products quickly!

Establishing an automated production system

You can create a process that can efficiently produce various types of products within a limited space.

It installs a conveyor belt through which materials pass through the editor and arranges the equipment to process it to produce the desired product. The product is then added through a delivery machine connected to the store, and finally sold to customers.

-Convenient line placement via Editor UI

-Simply click to view resource supply and control, production process

-More than 160 product recipes

-Provides a variety of convenience features for design (favorites, blueprints, status records, etc.)

-Process testing with simulation capabilities

Establishing management and sales strategies

You can predict demand and understand market trends to sell your products to as many customers as possible.

-Financing and performing a number of challenges

-30 different customer characters

-a local store with a different theme

-Detailed strategy composition (utilization of product price, target tier setting, reputation/maintenance rate, etc.)

-Testing demand forecasting with simulation capabilities

Expansion and Growth

You can take advantage of a number of content that expands and grows your store to build more wealth and elevate your ranking.

-Expand the process with new land purchases

-Produce more products with faster time through facility enhancement

-Increased customer numbers with enhanced stores and new store openings

-Raise your rating through higher returns and become a paragon for residents

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: 2GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Macaronpolis is a simulation game that creates an efficient and universal process for customers to produce the products they want. You develop sales strategies by predicting customer demand, developing production designs, and sometimes finding solutions to problems faced by neighbors.
